{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.33) to counteract overconfidence.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent 7-day true values show strong upward momentum (e.g., >+5% daily avg).",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is >+15% above 30-day moving average, reduce by 10-15%.",
    "Increase forecast lag by 1-2 days if sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0.50) and price is trending upward.",
    "Cap forecast spikes above 10% above recent peak to prevent overshoot in bullish sentiment periods.",
    "If sentiment is positive and forecast is below 30-day MA, increase by 5-8% to align with sentiment momentum.",
    "Use sentiment-weighted smoothing: if sentiment > 0.50, apply 20% weight to recent true values; if < 0.33, apply 15% weight to true values."
  ]
}
